_comment: The checkout and purchase-confirmation screens -- the last thing you see after clicking Buy, and the instructions for collecting the item in game.
Uyarı! Limitli süreye sahip eşyalar sade: Warning! Time-limited items can only be used until their expiry date. Please check the date.
1) Oyunu başlatın ve eşyayı satın aldığı: 1) Start the game and log in to the server where you bought the item.
2) Hangi karakterle eşyayı teslim almak: 2) Select the character you want to collect the item with.
3) Ekranın sağ tarafında bulunan Item De: 3) Click the Item Storage icon on the right of the screen and your purchased items will be there. Clicking [take] in that list transfers the selected item to your inventory.
